Name: smacznego
Note: Said to someone who is about to eat.

Name: mieć
Note: mam, masz, ma… Also used for age: Mam siedem lat = I'm seven.

Name: prosić
Note: Proszę = please; here you are; you're welcome. Prosić o + accusative = to ask for.

Name: poprosić
Note: Poproszę… = I'd like…, please. The polite way to order.

Name: podać
English: to pass, to hand; to serve

Name: czekać
Note: Czekać na + accusative = to wait for.

Name: w
Note: Takes the locative for 'where': w kawiarni = in the café.

Name: z
Note: Becomes ze before some consonant clusters: ze straganu.

Name: dla
Note: Takes the genitive: dla Oli = for Ola.

Name: od
Note: Takes the genitive: od Basi = from Basia.

Name: pod
Note: Takes the instrumental for 'where': pod ławką.

Name: o
English: about; for (prosić o = ask for); oh!

Name: czy
Note: Starts a yes/no question: Czy możesz…? = Can you…? Also 'or' in questions.

Name: razem
Note: Also a form of raz: za pierwszym razem = the first time.

Name: to
Note: X to Y = X is Y: Józef to mój brat.

Name: słówko
Note: A small, friendly form of słowo (word).

Name: pies
Note: Irregular: psa, psem. The e drops out.

Name: rynek
Note: The main square of a Polish town. Rynku: the e drops out.

Name: rok
Note: After numbers from 5 up, 'years' is lat: siedem lat.

Name: drożdżówka
Note: A bakery favourite, often with crumble on top.

Name: herbata
Note: In Poland often served in a glass, with lemon.

Name: miś
Note: Animate, so the object form is misia.

Name: filemon
English: Filemon: a cat's name, after the kitten in the cartoon Bonifacy i Filemon

Name: basia
English: Basia: a woman's name, short for Barbara

Name: ola
English: Ola: a woman's name, short for Aleksandra

Name: kuba
English: Kuba: a boy's name, short for Jakub (Jacob)

Name: zosia
English: Zosia: a woman's name, short for Zofia (Sophie)

Name: chodzić
English: to walk, to go on foot (often, or there and back)

Name: list
Note: A false friend: an English list is lista.

Name: widzenie
Note: Mostly met in do widzenia = goodbye.

Name: środek
Note: W środku = inside. Środku: the e drops out.

Name: raz
Note: Na razie = see you; for now.

Name: burek
English: Burek: the classic Polish dog's name, from bury (greyish brown)

Name: kraków
English: Kraków: a city in southern Poland

Name: klasy
Note: Grać w klasy = to play hopscotch. Klasa alone means a class.

Name: grać
Note: Grać na + locative for an instrument: gram na akordeonie.

Name: nuty
Note: Nuta is one note; nuty are the printed music.

Name: parasolka
Note: A small parasol: the one you carry.

Name: już
Note: Nie mam już… = I have no more…

Name: zuzia
English: Zuzia: a girl's name, short for Zuzanna (Susanna)

Name: staszek
English: Staszek: a man's name, short for Stanisław (Stanley)

Name: krysia
English: Krysia: a woman's name, short for Krystyna (Christine)

Name: się
Note: One of the most common words: Jak się masz? = How are you? Uczyć się = to study.

Name: wiedzieć
Note: wiem, wiesz, wie… Nie wiem = I don't know.

Name: uczyć
Note: Uczyć się = to learn, to study.

Name: miło
Note: Miło cię widzieć = nice to see you.

Name: pan
English: Mr; sir; you (polite, to a man)
Note: Polish uses pan and pani as the polite 'you'.

Name: nigdy
Note: Polish says nigdy nie: never not.

Name: nikt
Note: With nie: nikt nie przychodzi = nobody comes.

Name: prawda
Note: At the end of a sentence: …, prawda? = …, right?

Name: nic
Note: With nie: nic nie wie = knows nothing.

Name: stać
Note: Stać się = to happen: co się stało? = what happened?

Name: siebie
Note: Sobie = (for) oneself: kupię sobie = I'll buy myself.

Name: trzeba
Note: Trzeba + infinitive: trzeba mówić = you have to say.

Name: oni
English: they (when men are in the group)

Name: ania
English: Ania: a woman's name, short for Anna

Name: tomek
English: Tomek: a boy's name, short for Tomasz (Thomas)

Name: źle
Note: Nie jest źle = it's not bad.

Name: kiedyś
English: once, some time ago; some day

Name: cóż
Note: A sigh of a word: cóż, takie jest życie.

Name: zaraz
Note: Zaraz wracam = I'll be right back.

Name: widać
Note: Like trzeba, it has no person: widać = you can see (it).

Name: słychać
Note: Co słychać? = what's new? how are things?

Name: można
Note: Można + infinitive: można siedzieć = you can sit.

Name: u
Note: Takes the genitive: u nas = at our place. Co u ciebie? = how are you doing?

Name: by
Note: Dobrze by było = it would be good.

Name: gdyby
Note: For things that aren't true: gdyby nie ona = if it weren't for her.

Name: nad
Note: Takes the instrumental: nad stawem = by the pond.

Name: one
English: they (no men in the group, or things)

Name: swój
Note: Points back at whoever the sentence is about.

Name: pani
English: Mrs; madam; lady; you (polite, to a woman)
Note: The polite 'you' for a woman, as pan is for a man.

Name: godzina
Note: Która (jest) godzina? = what time is it?

Name: wydawać
Note: Wydaje mi się = it seems to me, I think.

Name: dziać
Note: Co się dzieje? = what's going on?

Name: dawać
Note: dać is the one-off form: daj! = give!

Name: bawić
Note: Bawić się = to play, to have fun.

Name: wyjechać
English: to go away, to leave (by vehicle)

Name: południe
Note: W południe = at noon. Z południa = from the south.

Name: myć
Note: Myć zęby = to brush your teeth.

Name: zejść
English: to come down, to get down

Name: zechcieć
English: to be willing, to like to

Name: bywać
English: to happen (now and then); to be (sometimes)

Name: znajdować
English: to find (with się = to be located)

Name: prędzej
Note: Prędzej czy później = sooner or later.

Name: wpaść
English: to drop in; to fall in

Name: odsunąć
English: to move away, to push back

Name: wchodzić
English: to go in, to come in

Name: obudzić
English: to wake (with się = to wake up)

Name: hania
English: Hania: a girl's name, short for Hanna

Name: sprawiać
Note: Sprawia mi radość = it gives me joy.

Name: pilnować
English: to look after, to keep an eye on

Name: laboratorium
Note: The same in every case in the singular.

Name: piętro
Note: Na pierwszym piętrze = on the first floor.

Name: przyznać
English: to admit (przyznać się = to own up)

Name: interes
Note: To nie twój interes = it's none of your business.

Name: wyprawiać
Note: Co ty wyprawiasz? = what are you up to?

Name: lewandowski
English: Lewandowski: a surname (Robert Lewandowski, the Polish footballer)

Name: piątka
English: five; top mark (a B in Poland, close to an A)

Name: powiedzenie
Note: Nie mam nic do powiedzenia = I've got nothing to say.

Name: woleć
Note: Wolę herbatę niż kawę = I prefer tea to coffee.

Name: wiadomo
Note: Like trzeba, it has no person.

Name: wolno
Note: Wolniej = slower. Nie wolno = you mustn't.

Name: obiad
Note: In Poland the main meal, eaten in the afternoon.

Name: myśl
Note: Also the command form of myśleć: think!

Name: oderwać
Note: Nie mogę oderwać oczu = I can't take my eyes off.

Name: przygotować
English: to prepare, to get ready (with się)

Name: podjąć
Note: Podjąć decyzję = to make a decision.

Name: spodobać
Note: Spodoba ci się = you'll like it.

Name: doczekać
Note: Nie mogę się doczekać = I can't wait.

Name: imieniny
Note: In Poland your name day is celebrated like a birthday.

Name: indziej
Note: Gdzie indziej / gdzieś indziej = somewhere else.

Name: święto
Note: Święta = Christmas or Easter, the holidays.

Name: brakować
Note: Brakuje cukru = we're out of sugar.

Name: szkodzić
Note: Nic nie szkodzi = no harm done, never mind.

Name: krok
Note: Krok po kroku = step by step.

Name: sens
Note: To nie ma sensu = it makes no sense.

Name: znaczenie
Note: To nie ma znaczenia = it doesn't matter.

Name: obawiać
Note: Obawiam się, że… = I'm afraid that…

Name: pora
Note: Pora na kawę! = time for coffee!

Name: przypadek
Note: W każdym przypadku = in every case.

Name: dwoje
English: two (children, or a man and a woman)

Name: potrzeba
Note: Nie ma potrzeby = there's no need.

Name: strzelać
Note: Strzelać gola = to score a goal.

Name: sala
Note: Na sali = indoors (in a sports hall).

Name: wrażenie
Note: Mam wrażenie, że… = I have a feeling that…

Name: wejść
English: to go in, to come in

Name: zacząć
Note: Zaczęło padać = it started to rain.

Name: pomyśleć
English: to think (once), to have a thought

Name: zakupy
Note: Robić zakupy = to do the shopping.

Name: dół
Note: Na dół = downstairs (where to); na dole = downstairs (where).

Name: góra
Note: W góry = to the mountains. Na górę = upstairs.

Name: zająć
Note: Zajmę się tym = I'll deal with it.

Name: ciąg
Note: W ciągu godziny = within an hour.

Name: zwrócić
English: to return; zwrócić uwagę = to pay attention

Name: wspólny
Note: Mieć coś wspólnego = to have something in common.

Name: kciuk
Note: Trzymać kciuki = to keep your fingers crossed.

Name: ela
English: Ela: a woman's name, short for Elżbieta

Name: bartek
English: Bartek: a boy's name, short for Bartłomiej

Name: jechać
English: to go (by car, bus), to drive
Note: Jadę, jedziesz, jedzie… One trip; jeździć is the habit.

Name: jeździć
English: to go (by vehicle) regularly, to drive

Name: centrum
Note: The same in every case in the singular.

Name: tydzień
Note: W tygodniu = in a week; during the week.

Name: emerytura
Note: Być na emeryturze = to be retired.

Name: około
Note: Takes the genitive: około dziesięciu osób.

Name: należeć
Note: Należy + infinitive = one should, you must.

Name: obchodzić
Note: Nie obchodzi mnie = I don't care.

Name: głowa
Note: Mieć coś na głowie = to have something on one's mind.

Name: jakoś
Note: Jakoś to będzie = it'll be all right somehow.

Name: mniej
Note: Mniej więcej = more or less, about.

Name: szkoda
Note: Szkoda, że… = it's a shame that…

Name: kasia
English: Kasia: a woman's name, short for Katarzyna

Name: podobać
Note: Podoba ci się? = do you like it? (lit. does it please you?)

Name: powinien
Note: Ends like a verb: powinienem = I (a man) should, powinniśmy = we should.

Name: stolik
Note: A little stół: the usual word in a café.

Name: drzwi
Note: Always plural, even for one door.

Name: żaden
Note: With nie: nie ma żadnych problemów = there are no problems at all.

Name: ogół
Note: W ogóle = at all; in general.

Name: między
Note: Między nami mówiąc = between you and me.

Name: wina
Note: To nie moja wina = it's not my fault.

Name: sprawa
Note: To moja sprawa = that's my business.

Name: poznać
English: to meet, to get to know
Note: Miło cię poznać = nice to meet you.

Name: pojęcie
Note: Nie mam pojęcia = I have no idea.

Name: udać
Note: Udało się! = it worked! I did it!

Name: aż
Note: Czekam, aż przyjdzie = I'm waiting until she comes.
